a: The Doge meme originated in 2010 when Japanese kindergarten teacher Atsuko Sato posted photos of her adopted Shiba Inu, Kabosu, on her personal blog. One particular photo showed Kabosu sitting on a sofa with a skeptical, raised-eyebrow expression. In 2013, the photo was posted on Reddit and Tumblr, where it quickly went viral. The meme features the dog's image overlaid with multicolored Comic Sans text representing an internal monologue using fractured English, such as 'wow,' 'such [adjective],' 'very [noun],' and 'so [adjective].' The deliberate misspellings and simple vocabulary became the hallmark of doge speak. The meme exploded in popularity in late 2013 and became one of the most recognizable internet memes of the decade. In 2014, the Doge meme inspired the creation of Dogecoin, a cryptocurrency originally created as a joke but which later gained significant real-world value. Kabosu the Shiba Inu passed away in May 2025 at the estimated age of 18. The Doge meme's legacy includes influencing internet language, inspiring cryptocurrency, and remaining a enduring symbol of internet culture.

q: how does overview effect change perspective
cognitive shift seeing earth from space
a: The Overview Effect is a cognitive shift in awareness reported by some astronauts during spaceflight, when viewing Earth from orbit or the lunar surface. The term was coined by author Frank White in 1987 in his book The Overview Effect: Space Exploration and the Human Evolution. Astronauts who experience the Overview Effect report a profound change in perspective, characterized by: a sense of Earth's fragility and thin atmosphere; the realization that national boundaries are human constructs invisible from space; a deep feeling of interconnectedness with all life on Earth; and a shift toward seeing humanity as a single species sharing one planet. The experience often leads to increased environmental awareness and a more global perspective. Apollo 14 astronaut Edgar Mitchell described it as a 'profound experience of interconnectedness.' The phenomenon is linked to the brain's response to the overwhelming novelty of seeing Earth as a whole against the blackness of space. Studies suggest that experiencing the Overview Effect can produce lasting changes in values, worldview, and behavior, similar to other transformative experiences.
